newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air Jet to launch Coventry-CDG freighter service.
newsitem.headline: Air Jet to launch Coventry-CDG freighter service.

text.p: Air Jet, airline subsidiary of French air and road express distribution company, Jet Services, said it will launch a nightly all-cargo rotation between Coventry and Paris-CDG from the end of October using a 4.5-tonne capacity Metroliner aircraft.

"The new freighter route is part of a strategy to extend the distribution network of our "next-day" European express service, Axor, which currently covers France, the Benelux and Germany " a Jet Services official told Reuters.
Axor has rented a 1,500 square metres building at Coventry airport and similar-sized facilties north of London, at the M25/A1(M) intersection, to handle shipments.

"By the end of next month, we plan to be offering UK firms located in the London/Birmingham business corridor next-day delivery deadlines between 00800 and 0900 (local time) to France, the Benelux and Germany," the official said.

The Coventry freighter would arrive at CDG at around midnight synchronising with Air Jet's other Metroliner's all-cargo flights into Paris from Liege in Belgium and Kassel in Germany and also the airline's BAe146 freighter flights from Marseille, Montpellier, Toulouse and Strasbourg, before returning to the West Midlands.
The Kassel-CDG rotation was being launched at the same time as Air Jet's Coventry-Paris rotation, the official added.
